safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated documentation does not state past history of anaphylaxis; it only states no current evidence of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute insect-sting/allergic-reaction encounter, documenting absence of prior anaphylaxis helps risk-stratify and informs decisions about ED referral, observation, and epinephrine prescribing. Omitting this negative history may lead subsequent clinicians to assume the history is unknown and manage more conservatively (e.g., unnecessary escalation), but is unlikely to directly cause harm in this case.
